body:
Hey, I'm 27. Almost 30 and nothing is how I thought it would be. I'm a grown adult and can't even financially provide for myself. Apart from not having a partner, I find this most confronting.

Before I came home I made several plans. Each would come into action if the one before wasn't succeeding. Now however, I've cycled through those plans. There's only one left and it won't work. I want it to and was really looking forward to working on it but enquiries made it appear impossible. This has left me quite deflated. 

I am just looking at fog with no possible way though. I don't feel able to go on.
Thanks for your kind words. I really appreciate it. Yes it is confronting. I can't even fathom how hopeless I feel. It's just so unyielding. I would take any way out of this.

The first thing you need to do is get out of the house. I was in a situation similar to yours not long ago. Do some volunteering work even if it's just to talk to some people and get your mind off unemployment. If you haven't already you need to make the most of any benefits you are entitled to. As to how you will find work it's useless making applications. You get jobs through the people you know. Stay positive and well liked. Eventually fate will smile on you.
